visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs is seen in a close-up, applying makeup to her cheek with a pink brush. She is wearing a soft lavender sweater and hair clips. (2) She points to specific areas on her face, like under her eyes and around her mouth, indicating concern about her skin texture. (3) She holds up a round white compact with the brand name 'Moody' visible on the lid. (4) She demonstrates the double-layered design of the compact, showing a fluffy puff on the top layer and a white pressed powder on the bottom layer. (5) She swatches the bright white powder onto the back of her hand to show its texture and color. (6) She uses the puff to carefully apply the powder to the tear trough area under her right eye. (7) A side-by-side comparison shows the right side of her face looking noticeably brighter and smoother than the left. (8) She applies more powder to the laugh lines near her nose and mouth. (9) Close-up shots show her applying the powder with both the puff and a small makeup brush for more precision. (10) She completes her look by applying blush and more highlighting powder to the bridge of her nose. (11) She smiles at the camera, showing a smooth and radiant final look.
